subject.title: fix(acp): drop current-turn image attachments already described by media understanding

question: Should ACP dispatch intentionally stop forwarding raw current-turn image attachments once media understanding has produced an `image.description` for the same attachment index?
rationale: The source fix matches the non-ACP path and appears technically sound, but it deliberately changes ACP runtime inputs and green CI cannot decide that compatibility boundary for existing ACP runtimes.

options.title: Require real ACP proof, then land
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal or live ACP output showing a text-only backend accepts the described image turn while undescribed, inline, extracted, and history images still follow the intended delivery rules.

options.title: Accept source proof only
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the tests and source proof as enough despite the external-PR real-behavior proof gate and own the ACP input compatibility change.

options.title: Pause for raw-image policy
options.body: If vision-capable ACP runtimes should keep receiving raw images even after descriptions, pause this PR and define a different attachment policy.

recommendation.title: Require real ACP proof, then land
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal or live ACP output showing a text-only backend accepts the described image turn while undescribed, inline, extracted, and history images still follow the intended delivery rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the ACP attachment forwarding behavior tied to mbelinky's ACP attachment history.
